basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old woman living in the Midwest, USA. I'm a marketing manager by day and a candle-making hobbyist by night. I recently got into Reddit to find communities that share my interest in home decor and scented candles. I enjoy reading and participating in discussions about lifestyle and home improvement. Outside work, I love hiking and spending time with my two cats. I'm single and enjoy the flexibility of working from home, which allows me to browse Reddit at various times throughout the day, mostly in the late evening.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Marketing and have been working in the field for over a decade. My interest in candles led me to learn about different wax types and scent combinations through online courses and workshops. I enjoy sharing my knowledge with others who are new to the hobby.
